opening.argument: The video actively promotes paid node participation and linked passive-income programs as a route to substantial recurring income. Its title claims that YieldNodes and StrongBlock Nodes are producing “HUGE passive income GAINS,” while the speaker highlights a 7.5% return and projects building $100,000 with “twenty percent plus twenty thousand a year.” This is not merely neutral reporting: he explains that participants must pay $14.95 monthly for each new node, describes withdrawing rewards to stake them and creating additional nodes, and provides a YieldNodes link for participation. He also assures viewers that investing in the promoted teams and platforms should turn out well. Although he gives a general disclaimer that crypto is not certain, the central communication remains endorsement and solicitation built around unusually high return claims.
